output.text: Hi Ren! I’m so excited to start writing to you. I collect odd buttons—my collection began when I found a tiny blue one in an old coat pocket. I ride a yellow bicycle everywhere, and it’s my favorite way to explore. I’d love to hear about the smallest adventure in your week—something small but meaningful. Maybe a new coffee shop you tried, or a chat with a stranger that made your day brighter. Let’s share our quiet moments. I’m looking forward to your letter!
